en: A monochrome postcard showing a riverside scene with trees lining the bank, a building or belvedere on a small hill to the left, and a large arched bridge over the river in the distance to the right. Several boats are moored along the shore. Below the image is printed text identifying the view, with a large area of handwritten Dutch correspondence filling the lower half of the card.
